row: Founded in 1900, Midwestern University is a not-for-profit graduate institution of higher education offering degrees in the health sciences on two campuses. Academic programs include osteopathic medicine, pharmacy, physician assistant studies, physical therapy, occupational therapy, podiatric medicine, clinical psychology, cardiovascular science/perfusion, nurse anesthesia, advanced nursing practice, nurse executive/global health leadership, dental medicine, optometry, veterinary medicine, speech-language pathology, public health, precision medicine, and biomedical sciences education.
